operations.name: Read and clean vector drawing geometry

actions.name: Inspect source entities, units and drawing contexts
actions.purpose: Identify the drawing entities and source conventions before modifying a derivative.
actions.intended_use: Prepare a requested planar layout or dimensioned profile with traceable source entities.
actions.inputs: Original DXF/SVG; file hash; intended layers/entities; model/paper-space choice; physical dimensions and target plane.
actions.outputs: Entity/context inventory and source-to-target map prerequisites for CAD-08-A02.
actions.accuracy: Preserve original coordinates and curve types; source dimension accuracy and target profile allowance have separate records.
actions.evidence: DXF entity/layer/block IDs and declared units; SVG viewBox, physical width/height, transforms and source annotations.
actions.software: Use ezdxf.readfile/modelspace queries or inspected native reader; inventory nested INSERT transforms, entity coordinate systems and unsupported types.
actions.agent: Identify profile versus annotation/construction geometry and whether SVG path centreline or styled outline supplies the intended shape.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve unitless source, drawing-space choice, stroke interpretation or required nonplanar projection.
actions.dependencies: Documented FreeCAD DXF/SVG import and ezdxf APIs; OCS read/schema interfaces for the actual session.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: drawing preflight retaining entity IDs, nested transforms, unit evidence and importer option receipt.
procedure: Hash the original and inspect file/importer metadata.
Inventory entities by space, layer, type and block occurrence.
Record SVG physical/viewBox mapping or DXF unit/frame interpretation.
actions.validation: Compare source controls and entity inventory; independent semantic reviewer checks selected profile/context and unit meaning.
actions.failure_resume: Retain unsupported entities and ambiguity locations; block dependent transformation until the named unit/context decision is supplied.
actions.resources: Metadata/stream reading first; local CPU/RAM grows with entities/nesting. Remote VLM uses original views for selection; record manual source-review effort.

actions.name: Create a mapped and explicitly cleaned derivative
actions.purpose: Transform selected source curves into the intended plane and apply only sourced repairs.
actions.intended_use: Supply a clean vector derivative for sketching while retaining original drawing evidence.
actions.inputs: Source inventory; selected entities; explicit unit/frame mapping; approved repair/approximation criteria.
actions.outputs: Clean vector derivative and per-entity preservation/change map for CAD-08-A03.
actions.accuracy: Gap closure, curve approximation and plane projection each have separate source-backed thresholds; repair limits preserve required holes/features.
actions.evidence: Every edited curve references source entity/occurrence and the reason for the change.
actions.software: Compose nested block transforms; apply object/world coordinates; preserve analytic curves where supported; detect duplicates/gaps/intersections before bounded joins or conversions.
actions.agent: Compare repair candidates using source curves and dimensions; VLM selects supported loop/feature interpretation.
actions.user_decisions: Decide a geometry-changing repair, projection or approximation when source intent permits several outcomes.
actions.dependencies: Native OCS/Draft edits or ezdxf derivative writer; actual supported entity behavior must be checked.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: curve mapping/repair helper with reversible source transform and per-edit change ledger.
procedure: Map selected entities with explicit transform order and units.
Detect and classify duplicate, open, crossing and nonplanar geometry.
Apply the permitted repair/conversion to a new derivative and retain mapping.
actions.validation: Nonuniform transforms preserve their actual curve result, such as circle-to-ellipse; compare repaired endpoints and source controls within their individual criteria.
actions.failure_resume: Preserve pre-edit derivative and failed mapping; return to the specific entity/repair rule and invalidate dependent loops.
actions.resources: Local transform/detection work scales with curve count and intersection candidates; expensive comparisons follow bounding filters. Remote review/manual edits address only ambiguous repairs.

actions.name: Validate curve fidelity and publish the vector handoff
actions.purpose: Confirm the cleaned derivative preserves the requested profile meaning and dimensional evidence.
actions.intended_use: Provide CAD-09/DOM-03 with explicit curve topology, units and source associations.
actions.inputs: Original and derivative; change ledger; source controls; loop/hole intent; target plane.
actions.outputs: Checked vector-drawing revision and curve comparison receipt for CAD-09/DOM-03.
actions.accuracy: Check individual dimensions, endpoints and curve deviation using sourced criteria; bounds/area supplement critical-feature checks.
actions.evidence: Actual derivative measurements name artifact hash and entity IDs; source statements retain their evidence status.
actions.software: Count by type/layer; check open endpoints, self-intersections, loop nesting, bounds and area; reopen the derivative.
actions.agent: Independent reviewer checks outer/hole loops and excluded annotation against original source views.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve a remaining source conflict affecting a named profile or hole.
actions.dependencies: Selected geometry reader/curve checker; independent reader when its coverage supports the entity set.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: source-to-curve fidelity reporter with feature-specific readiness and lost-entity findings.
procedure: Compare entity/change manifests and named source controls.
Inspect closedness, crossings and nested-loop semantics.
Reopen derivative and publish ready/blocked profiles by target action.
actions.validation: Require numerical source correspondence and independent loop/feature review; unsupported entity losses remain explicit failures for required geometry.
actions.failure_resume: Retain failed derivative and exact missing/changed entity; resume the owning normalization/repair step.
actions.resources: Local topology checks scale with curves/intersections; views add display cost. Record remote review calls, source image size and manual correspondence corrections.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent interprets unfamiliar drawing structure and selects source-supported entities/repairs; tools measure and preserve source mappings.
execution_modes.hybrid: Parser handles units/entities/transforms; agent/VLM chooses profile associations and repair meaning.
execution_modes.software_first: Known exporter/layer/entity families use checked normalization; unsupported entities or geometry-changing repairs enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Explicit entity selection, transforms and tested repair rules replay against pinned source/importer revisions.

alternatives: Keep native source curves unchanged when the intended use needs no cleanup.
Layout profiles may use a labelled approximation with its deviation record; precision profiles preserve required curves and feature criteria.
Choose FreeCAD native/legacy DXF importer, OCS drawing workflow or ezdxf parser according to exercised entity coverage.

merge.branches: Separate importer/repair candidates retain one source hash, source subset, intended use/detail, per-feature criteria and resources.
merge.evaluation: VLM compares full source views and curve labels; software compares entity maps, critical dimensions and deviations.
merge.combination: Combine compatible mapped loops from the same source meaning; retain conflicting repairs and dimensions without averaging.
merge.post_merge: Recheck merged loop nesting, source mapping, units, critical dimensions and independent semantic correspondence.

operations.software_migration: Automate known entity mappings and transform rules after checked nested blocks, SVG physical scaling, unsupported entities, gap/duplicate and nonuniform-transform cases; keep source/repair interpretation as an exception path.
future_tests: Nested DXF blocks and mixed object/world coordinates reproduce checked control points.
SVG viewBox and physical units produce expected scale; centreline versus stroke outline requires the stated choice.
A nonuniformly scaled arc retains its transformed geometry instead of silently becoming a circle.
Near endpoints, duplicates and self-intersections preserve the original and the exact repair decision.
Required holes survive cleanup despite matching aggregate bounds.

operations.name: Build and constrain an editable planar sketch

actions.name: Map curves and sourced constraints to a sketch plan
actions.purpose: Associate source geometry with the intended sketch elements and driving relationships.
actions.intended_use: Prepare an editable planar sketch for the requested geometry family.
actions.inputs: Vector-drawing plus model-brief, dimensions or measurement-set; support plane, datum and source-to-entity map.
actions.outputs: Sketch element/constraint plan for CAD-09-A02.
actions.accuracy: Dimensional allowances, source uncertainty and solver thresholds remain separate; no default tolerance or universal full-constraint requirement.
actions.evidence: Each proposed geometric/dimensional constraint cites source intent or explicit task decision.
actions.software: Resolve element IDs and plane coordinates; check curve support, loop closure and duplicate constraint candidates.
actions.agent: Distinguish driving dimensions, reference dimensions, construction geometry and intended free motion.
actions.user_decisions: Supply a missing design relation or intended degree of freedom when the source cannot determine it.
actions.dependencies: FreeCAD Sketcher addGeometry/addConstraint documentation; OCS sketch/constraint use requires discovered actual support.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: source-to-sketch constraint mapper with stable geometry IDs and intended freedom records.
procedure: Select support plane and named datum.
Map source curves and construction elements to sketch IDs.
Attach each driving/reference relation and intended freedom to its source.
actions.validation: Check every constraint references correct elements and units; independent reviewer verifies diameter/radius, centre/edge and hole-loop meaning.
actions.failure_resume: Preserve ambiguous constraints as candidates; resume the affected feature after the exact design/source decision.
actions.resources: Local mapping checks depend on entity/constraint count. High-reasoning/VLM review addresses ambiguous relation meaning; record manual decisions.

actions.name: Create the sketch and solve bounded constraint groups
actions.purpose: Apply the planned constraints while recording solver changes and remaining freedoms.
actions.intended_use: Produce a native constraint-bearing sketch with explicit interpretation provenance.
actions.inputs: Checked sketch plan; target document/revision; chosen Sketcher or supported equivalent; solver configuration.
actions.outputs: Constrained-sketch candidate and solve history for CAD-09-A03.
actions.accuracy: Use the sourced dimension values; solver numerical tolerance controls solving only and does not replace feature allowance.
actions.evidence: Run receipts identify created geometry/constraints, document revisions, solver state and actual tool version.
actions.software: Create geometry; add constraints in diagnosable groups; solve/recompute and collect remaining degrees of freedom, redundancy and conflict reports. Record each diagnostic's actual API, value and supported status; an unavailable required diagnostic yields an unresolved check and blocks its dependent readiness claim.
actions.agent: Interpret whether remaining freedom is intended and diagnose the smallest conflicting constraint group.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve competing source dimensions or a newly needed constraint; avoid arbitrary fixation of free geometry.
actions.dependencies: FreeCAD Sketcher APIs/version; OCS equivalent only after installed capability inspection. The archived FreeCAD Sketcher example establishes addGeometry/addConstraint/recompute; the selected version's actual diagnostic API must be discovered for solver state, remaining degrees of freedom, conflicts and residuals.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: incremental constraint adapter and conflict reporter preserving source-to-constraint relationships.
procedure: Create native sketch geometry with stable readable associations.
Apply constraints in dependency order and record each solve result.
Retain intended free variables and isolate redundant/conflicting constraints.
actions.validation: Inspect solver state/residuals and movement from source geometry; a solved sketch must also satisfy source-to-constraint correspondence.
actions.failure_resume: Preserve last consistent revision and conflicting IDs; revise the owning source/constraint interpretation and rerun the affected solve group.
actions.resources: Local solver CPU/RAM scales with constraints and connectivity. Remote reasoning diagnoses semantics; manual work concerns exact conflict decisions.

actions.name: Measure and reopen the constrained sketch
actions.purpose: Verify dimensional intent, topology and native editability on the resulting sketch.
actions.intended_use: Deliver a checked constrained profile for a compatible solid operation.
actions.inputs: Solved sketch; source curves/constraints; feature criteria; intended degrees of freedom; native save path.
actions.outputs: Native sketch revision and validation receipt for CAD-10/DOM-04.
actions.accuracy: Check each driving feature and curve deviation independently of solver residual; perturbation uses explicitly supplied variant values.
actions.evidence: Measurements bind to sketch/constraint IDs and revision; source-controlled variant expectations remain labeled.
actions.software: Measure critical dimensions, closure/nesting/intersections; save/reopen and, when authorized, recompute one declared parameter variant.
actions.agent: Independent reviewer compares source feature associations and intended free variables with the saved sketch.
actions.user_decisions: Provide a required variant value/expected response if parametric behavior testing is requested.
actions.dependencies: Native Sketcher measurements/recompute and save/reopen; separate reader for supported geometry checks.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: sketch evidence validator linking solver, geometry and native parameter behavior.
procedure: Read back constraint values and feature geometry.
Validate loop/region structure and intended freedom.
Save/reopen; exercise a supplied parameter variant when within scope.
actions.validation: Solver consistency, source correctness and saved editability are separate findings; detect a fully constrained wrong loop.
actions.failure_resume: Preserve failed sketch/variant; return to owning mapping or solve step and invalidate dependent solids.
actions.resources: Local readback precedes variant recompute; effort scales with sketch dependencies. Remote/manual source review and local graphics are recorded separately.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent chooses source-backed geometry/constraints and inspects each solve group.
execution_modes.hybrid: Software creates and solves mapped constraints; agent reviews source associations and residual/conflict meaning.
execution_modes.software_first: Checked sketch families use established constraint templates; unsupported curve/freedom/conflict cases enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Pinned curves, source values and explicit constraints solve and validate using a fixed supported backend/version.

alternatives: Keep nonparametric vector curves when that is the requested editable artifact; label their output separately.
Use a native constraint-bearing FreeCAD sketch for editable dimensions.
Use a code-defined profile where procedural source is requested, with that output representation explicit.

merge.branches: Alternative constraint sets share source revision and intended use; record permitted freedom and per-feature accuracy for each.
merge.evaluation: VLM/source review compares geometric associations; software compares actual constraint values, residuals and remaining freedoms.
merge.combination: Merge compatible relation records only after checking duplicate/redundant/contradictory constraints; preserve competing interpretations.
merge.post_merge: Solve again and independently review merged source associations, loops, remaining freedom and saved sketch.

operations.software_migration: Capture solved, source-correct sketch families; automate stable constraints after underconstraint, contradiction, redundancy, wrong-loop and supplied-variant fixtures pass.
future_tests: A deliberately free degree of freedom remains free and is documented.
A redundant and a contradictory dimension produce distinct findings with source IDs.
A fully constrained wrong hole/edge association fails semantic review.
Saved/reopened sketch preserves constraint values and intended parameter response.

Selected sketch interface returns geometry but lacks a required degrees-of-freedom, conflict or residual diagnostic: preserve source constraints and actual supported readings, record the missing diagnostic as unavailable, and leave the affected validation unresolved until a supported query or explicitly justified independent check supplies it.

operations.name: Create a kernel solid and native model document from confirmed parameters

actions.name: Select a supported solid feature route
actions.purpose: Map confirmed profile/parameter intent to actual kernel operations and output requirements.
actions.intended_use: Construct the requested named B-rep solids and editable native representation.
actions.inputs: Constrained-sketch, compatible parametric-source, or model-brief plus dimensions; units, axes, part boundaries and feature criteria.
actions.outputs: Feature/backend plan for CAD-10-A02.
actions.accuracy: Feature dimensions and allowance come from sources; kernel operation tolerance, solver criteria and later export thresholds remain separate.
actions.evidence: Source profile and parameter records; installed capability evidence; prior OCS kernel note remains a historical source report.
actions.software: Inspect backend version/API and actual curve/solid support; verify closed profile, finite inputs, extrusion direction or revolution axis/sweep.
actions.agent: Choose primitive/extrude/revolve/Boolean sequence preserving separate parts and required surfaces.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve feature direction, body fusion or backend/representation change when task intent is ambiguous.
actions.dependencies: OCS SolidOperation enum/source implements create, rigid transform, region/surface, extrude and Boolean; REVOLVE uses its command path. FreeCAD/CadQuery/build123d are documented alternatives.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: feature capability planner with explicit profile, operand and representation prerequisites.
procedure: Identify the required solid and native editable output.
Bind each feature to source values/profile/axis and supported operation.
Record operand roles, component boundaries and per-feature checks.
actions.validation: Plan uses actual available operations and sourced dimensions. OCS plugin Extrude accepts one curve-profile handle and rejects Region; closed profile yields Solid3D and open profile yields Surface. A required solid from an open profile blocks construction until sourced closure or an evidenced alternate route exists. Outer/inner hole loops require an expressly supported operation sequence/backend.
actions.failure_resume: Preserve unsupported feature plan and query exact missing input; select an authorized supported alternative before dependent construction.
actions.resources: Metadata/profile checks first; local CPU/RAM scales with feature/operand complexity. High-reasoning agent handles ambiguous topology/sequence; record manual decisions.

actions.name: Construct features with revision-bound readback
actions.purpose: Create the planned bodies without losing operands or obscuring partial failures.
actions.intended_use: Produce kernel geometry for the declared part/assembly boundaries.
actions.inputs: Feature plan; source profiles/operands; target document/revision; supported command/plugin interface.
actions.outputs: Body candidate, feature lineage and operation receipts for CAD-10-A03.
actions.accuracy: Apply exact supplied values; record kernel tolerances/healing and any approximation against feature-specific limits.
actions.evidence: Receipts include tool/build, document revision, input/output handles and source feature IDs; body creation differs from STEP export.
actions.software: Execute bounded primitive/extrude/revolve/Boolean operations and query each actual result. For OCS Python methods explicitly record and pass delete_source=False for region/surface/extrude when preserving the profile, and keep_operands=True for union/subtract/intersect when preserving operands. An explicitly selected deletion policy uses its recorded flags; the inspected Boolean default keep_operands=False consumes operands.
actions.agent: Diagnose profile, coincidence, Boolean refusal and changed history from actual returned errors.
actions.user_decisions: Decide a geometry-changing workaround, history loss or altered part boundary when it changes the requested result.
actions.dependencies: Installed OCS command/plugin path; FreeCAD Part/PartDesign or CadQuery/build123d selected API; native syntax discovered before use. OCS plugin single-profile extrusion, Region rejection and Boolean operand/profile deletion flags are checked explicitly; REVOLVE is a command path, not an inspected plugin enum variant.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: bounded feature executor with stable request IDs, operand lineage and explicit result representation.
procedure: Read target revision and operand handles; record the selected profile/operand preservation policy and explicit delete_source/keep_operands flags.
Create the next supported feature with those flags, identified operands and a stable request identity.
Read actual body/surface type, new handles and retained/deleted operand handles; stop dependent features on a failure.
actions.validation: Check finite bounds, resulting component count and required feature after each stage; detect open-profile surface result, invalid Boolean and unwanted fusion. Compare actual retained/deleted handles with the flag receipt; default Boolean behavior cannot stand in for an operand-preserving policy.
actions.failure_resume: Reconcile uncertain request status before retry; retain committed steps and refusal text such as CutRefused/Coincident/NoClosedForm where returned; resume from the first failed feature.
actions.resources: Local Boolean/kernel work can dominate simple profile checks; record actual face/feature counts and build mode. Remote agent diagnoses exceptions; GPU is display-only unless actual backend uses it.

actions.name: Verify native solid and saved construction record
actions.purpose: Confirm actual shape validity, required dimensions and native artifact preservation.
actions.intended_use: Deliver cad-solid and native-model-document for further modeling or controlled exchange.
actions.inputs: Constructed bodies; feature plan; source controls; native representation contract; supplied variant if requested.
actions.outputs: Native model, actual solid classification and verification receipt consumed by CAD-13/DOM-04/DOM-05.
actions.accuracy: Use sourced per-feature criteria for sizes/axes/clearances; source uncertainty and computational comparison thresholds remain distinct.
actions.evidence: Actual geometry queries identify saved revision and handles; OCS same-kernel roundtrip is labeled with its shared dependency.
actions.software: Check validity, solids/shells/face types, critical dimensions and valid volume; save/reopen native result; retain parametric source or feature tree according to the chosen backend.
actions.agent: Independent reviewer checks cut direction, axes, component separation and source correspondence using same-revision views.
actions.user_decisions: Supply a variant value/expected response if parametric edit behavior must be tested.
actions.dependencies: Native CAD readback/save; CAD-13 validation contract; exact source exporter route checked separately.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: native-body invariant report with source-to-feature IDs and editability classification.
procedure: Measure actual controlling features and shape structure.
Save and reopen the native artifact.
Compare a supplied parameter variant when authorized and preserve its separate result.
actions.validation: Validate topology and critical interfaces beyond bounds/volume; report actual native history/source retention and independent-reader dependencies.
actions.failure_resume: Keep failed saved/variant artifact; return to the owning feature and invalidate its downstream exports/checks.
actions.resources: Local shape/reopen costs depend on faces and feature history; start with counts and required features. Remote/VLM semantic review uses bounded views; manual corrections logged.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent chooses source-backed feature sequence and drives supported native operations with readback.
execution_modes.hybrid: Software constructs explicit features; agent interprets source intent and diagnoses Boolean/profile exceptions.
execution_modes.software_first: Checked feature families execute with explicit parameters; unsupported curves, refusal or history mismatch enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Pinned feature sequence, backend and parameters regenerate named bodies and validate native save/readback.

alternatives: OCS native kernel body via the actually exposed command/plugin interface.
FreeCAD feature-history model when native editable feature dependencies are required.
CadQuery/build123d source and B-rep when procedural parameters are the chosen editable record.
Simplified layout geometry may be a separate declared derivative; OpenSCAD CSG mesh uses CAD-15 and its own output type.

merge.branches: Candidate construction sequences preserve the same source parameters and part identities while recording detail/use/criteria/resources.
merge.evaluation: Source/VLM review compares feature meaning; kernel checks compare surfaces, critical dimensions and topology.
merge.combination: Select a checked body or compose separately intended parts; cross-branch feature copying creates a new authored revision with explicit lineage.
merge.post_merge: Recheck resulting body validity, component boundaries, interfaces, source correspondence and native reopen; separate reviewer evaluates semantics.

operations.software_migration: Automate a feature family only after checked primitive, closed/open extrusion, axis/sign, Boolean refusal, saved readback and supplied-variant cases; capability gates remain version-specific.
future_tests: Open-profile extrusion yields a surface and fails a requested closed-solid contract.
Closed-profile extrusion preserves sourced direction, voids and part boundary.
Wrong revolve axis/sign can preserve bounds yet fail source feature checks.
Boolean refusal preserves operands and resumes without duplicate mutations.
Native SAT/SAB byte changes retain checked geometry while source and saved hashes remain distinct.
Region input fails OCS plugin extrusion before mutation; an open profile blocks a required-solid route; an outer-plus-hole profile uses an evidenced supported feature sequence and preserves the hole.

OCS region/surface/extrude with recorded delete_source=False retain the profile; Boolean with recorded keep_operands=True retains both operands. A separately authorized deletion fixture uses explicit flags and verifies only the selected deletion. The fixture exposes the consuming Boolean default.

operations.name: Verify model geometry and saved output

actions.name: Bind checks to actual artifacts and source criteria
actions.purpose: Define which factual claims can be checked from the supplied representation.
actions.intended_use: Inspect native models, sketches, solids, meshes, scripts or an existing fabrication package for the requested use.
actions.inputs: Artifact/revision/hash; model brief/source controls; intended use; per-feature criteria and representation.
actions.outputs: Check plan and evidence prerequisites for CAD-13-A02.
actions.accuracy: Keep feature allowance, source uncertainty, solver tolerance and file-comparison threshold distinct.
actions.evidence: Source controls and actual artifact identity; a parametric-source input alone supports source/provenance checks until geometry or an exercised generation receipt exists.
actions.software: Inventory artifact type and available measurements; map each check to source feature and supported query.
actions.agent: Select checks appropriate to curves/solids/mesh/native history and identify independent control evidence.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve a required acceptance criterion or source ambiguity that changes the named check.
actions.dependencies: Native measurement APIs and actual independent consumer; OCS numerical helper checks supplied point/axis/plane values only.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: representation-aware validation planner with per-claim evidence requirements.
procedure: Freeze artifact identity and intended-use requirements.
Associate each claim with its source criterion and measurable feature.
Separate available source checks from geometry checks needing an actual generated artifact.
actions.validation: Every planned numeric result has units, frame, criterion source and actual measurement route; reviewer checks feature identity.
actions.failure_resume: Record exact unavailable prerequisite and blocked check; preserve independent eligible checks and resume after the artifact/evidence arrives.
actions.resources: Metadata planning first; local CPU small relative to geometry queries for the same artifact. Remote/manual review concerns source associations and criteria.

actions.name: Read actual geometry and compare required features
actions.purpose: Measure the named artifact using supported queries and retain failures.
actions.intended_use: Produce numerical and structural findings for the requested model use.
actions.inputs: Check plan; fixed document/artifact revision; geometry query route; source references.
actions.outputs: Measurement-set and check findings for CAD-13-A03.
actions.accuracy: Compare each feature against its own source-backed threshold; geometry precision and evidence uncertainty remain explicit.
actions.evidence: Measurements record artifact/document revision, handles/features, tool/version, units/frame, query and values.
actions.software: Measure critical dimensions/axes, shape counts/topology, validity and applicable volume; inspect mesh degeneracy/normals/closedness when relevant.
actions.agent: Independent reviewer checks that each numeric query addresses the intended feature; VLM compares same-revision views and source references.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve source/design conflicts revealed by checks; verification itself preserves existing geometry.
actions.dependencies: Native kernel/mesh query APIs; point/axis/plane helper only after actual measurement extraction.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: measured-check recorder with supported-query classification and independent semantic association.
procedure: Query required features from the fixed revision.
Run representation-specific validity/structure checks.
Compare sourced criteria and retain both pass and failed results.
actions.validation: Cross-check critical features using independent controls/readers where appropriate; equal bounds/volume do not replace local interface checks.
actions.failure_resume: Preserve actual failed values/query errors; geometry changes belong to the owning construction action after diagnosis.
actions.resources: Required-feature queries precede broad topology/mesh scans; local CPU/RAM scales with geometry size. Remote VLM and manual measurement review tracked separately.

actions.name: Reopen saved artifacts and issue the verification report
actions.purpose: Associate verification with the actual saved output consumed downstream.
actions.intended_use: Deliver measurement-set and verification-report for the exact native/neutral artifact.
actions.inputs: Saved output and hash; check findings; native source revision; chosen reader; any authorized save scope.
actions.outputs: Verification-report with preserved failures, output identities and named downstream readiness.
actions.accuracy: Repeat required feature comparisons using export/readback thresholds; retain source engineering allowances separately.
actions.evidence: Output hash, reader/kernel version, source revision and field-loss findings identify the checked transition.
actions.software: Open saved artifact read-only; compare identities/units/frames/geometry; use OCS audit/save_verified only for its supported targets and authorized save.
actions.agent: Separate reviewer compares source-to-output semantic mapping and native editability/history versus actual exchange content.
actions.user_decisions: Resolve a changed delivery representation if a required field fails preservation.
actions.dependencies: Native reader and supported independent consumer; OCS verified DWG/DXF save scope; STEP checked through its actual importer.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: saved-artifact verification receipt with shared-kernel dependency record and explicit per-check status.
procedure: Reopen the named saved artifact.
Repeat required feature and representation checks.
Write actual values, failed checks, mappings and hashes into the report.
actions.validation: Report passes apply only to checked revisions; a fabrication package remains an inspected input and verification creates its report.
actions.failure_resume: Retain failed file/reader diagnostics; route to CAD-14 with the failed transition and affected feature IDs; rerun only affected checks after correction.
actions.resources: Local reopen/query costs follow file/geometry size; record reader CPU/RAM and I/O. Remote/manual review checks mappings, failures and intended use.

execution_modes.agent_led: Agent builds a use-specific check plan and directs actual measurements; software records and compares values.
execution_modes.hybrid: Software runs planned geometry checks; agent reviews feature correspondence and exceptions.
execution_modes.software_first: Supported artifact/check families run automatically; unsupported queries, missing source criteria and semantic changes enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Pinned artifact, criteria and supported queries produce a repeatable result; independent semantic evidence remains linked to its reviewed case.

alternatives: Native-only readback for the requested native artifact, recording its actual scope.
Neutral-file roundtrip through the intended consumer with source-to-output mapping.
Mesh-specific checks for a declared mesh deliverable; source-only verification for a supplied script until geometry evidence exists.

merge.branches: Readers/check methods share artifact/source identities, intended claim and criteria; record independent/shared kernel and resource conditions.
merge.evaluation: Reasoning/VLM review evaluates source-feature meaning; numerical results compare named quantities rather than model votes.
merge.combination: Combine compatible check findings by feature and exact revision; preserve conflicting measurements and query conditions.
merge.post_merge: Validate report references, units, criteria and source-to-feature associations; a different artifact requires its own measurements.

operations.software_migration: Retain checked measurement mappings and expected failures; automate supported query families after wrong-feature, stale-view, source-only-script, faceted/analytic and saved-roundtrip cases.
future_tests: A script without generated geometry yields only source checks and explicit geometry prerequisites.
Correct bounds with a wrong hole fails the required interface check.
A screenshot from another revision fails association even when visually similar.
Native and neutral-reader agreement records shared-kernel dependency.
Existing fabrication-package input produces inspection findings without generating replacement fabrication artifacts.

operations.name: Recover from failed interpretation or geometry construction

actions.name: Reconcile the failed operation and preserve its evidence
actions.purpose: Determine the actual completion state before proposing a retry.
actions.intended_use: Recover the specific failed modeling transition while preserving existing work.
actions.inputs: Model-brief; verification-report naming failed transition/artifact; request/document/revision IDs; logs and partial outputs.
actions.outputs: Reconciled failure receipt and unchanged evidence set for CAD-14-A02.
actions.accuracy: Preserve actual failed values and their units/criteria; operation-completion identity requires exact matching.
actions.evidence: Native operation status, completed steps, output hashes and prior successful revision establish the diagnostic boundary.
actions.software: Query the same operation identity after timeout; read document revision/handles and partial output without replaying mutations.
actions.agent: Compare actual state with intended transition and locate which steps committed.
actions.user_decisions: Clarify an ambiguous requested recovery scope or changed source requirement.
actions.dependencies: OCS operation-status and revision protocol; backend logs; saved artifact/hash records.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: failure-state collector linking request state, artifact revisions and affected feature IDs.
procedure: Retain failed report, source inputs and partial outputs.
Query actual completion using the original identity.
Record completed and incomplete steps plus affected dependants.
actions.validation: Verify reported failure refers to the observed artifact/revision; independent reviewer checks the diagnostic source boundary.
actions.failure_resume: Unavailable completion state remains an explicit reconciliation prerequisite; retain outputs and resume query before any duplicate mutation.
actions.resources: Local logs/state/hash work precedes new geometry. Remote reasoning examines evidence; manual effort resolves only source/scope ambiguity.

actions.name: Diagnose the earliest invalid source-to-geometry transition
actions.purpose: Identify the first interpretation, constraint, operation or export condition causing the failure.
actions.intended_use: Produce a source-backed correction proposal for the affected feature.
actions.inputs: Reconciled failure receipt; original source views/values; constraint residuals; kernel errors; importer/exporter findings.
actions.outputs: Diagnosis with candidate corrections and dependencies for CAD-14-A03.
actions.accuracy: Use the original per-feature criteria; changing solver/repair tolerances is a separate justified proposal.
actions.evidence: Source overlay, actual residual/error and operation lineage support each diagnosis; model confidence has its own status.

execution_modes.agent_led: High-reasoning agent derives source-supported parameters/features and authors reviewed source; software generates and measures.
execution_modes.hybrid: Software supplies parameter/dependency checks and geometry construction; agent reviews feature meaning and selector exceptions.
execution_modes.software_first: Checked parametric families use fixed generators; out-of-range conditions, unsupported features and semantic changes enter review.
execution_modes.deterministic: Pinned source/environment/parameters produce actual supported geometry and declared invariant/variant checks.

common_protocol.evidence_and_identity: Each branch binds source hashes/revisions, intended use, target representation, feature IDs, units/frame, required detail/coverage and feature-specific criteria. Each action receipt records actual tool/API/build, input/output revisions, request/run ID and evidence status. A pinned revision is an explicitly fixed revision or content hash.
common_protocol.accuracy: For every tested feature retain nominal value, unit, source locator/status, engineering allowance, measurement uncertainty, solver criterion where used and saved/export comparison threshold separately. A residual is the measured difference after a constraint or geometric comparison; its method, frame and unit are explicit. Topology describes connections among vertices, edges and faces. Source controls establish meaning; kernel or numerical checks establish their measured subset.
common_protocol.validation_roles: The interpreting/producing agent and semantic reviewer use distinct execution instances. Record both actual exposed identities, requested configurations and shared source/model/kernel dependencies. A separate reader/query implementation is preferred for numerical readback when supported; same-kernel tests retain that shared dependency. Required unavailable diagnostics remain unresolved and block only named dependent readiness.
common_protocol.branch_merge: Parallel branches write separate artifacts. Common source/feature/frame records allow comparisons even when layout detail and precision detail differ. Classify interpretation, units/frame, representation and geometry differences before VLM selection. VLM means vision-language model: it examines cited source regions, full views and actual query reports, then selects evidence-supported candidates or compatible contributions. Preserve conflicting values and branch lineage; incompatible dimensions are never averaged. Every combined artifact receives a new revision and repeated source, structure, feature and saved-output checks.
common_protocol.native_failure_resume: Retain source, last checked native revision, action request identity, actual logs, partial artifacts and completed-step/next-step evidence. For uncertain native completion, query the same request/document/revision and actual handles before retry. Reconcile already completed changes and resume the first uncompleted action. A changed input invalidates only dependent descendants.
common_protocol.remote_failure_resume: For interrupted or uncertain reasoning/VLM completion retain provider/request ID when exposed, exact prompt/input/source hashes, model settings and raw or partial response. Reconcile provider completion before retry when supported; otherwise record uncertainty and retry lineage under a new call identity. Parse and validate all selected feature IDs, source citations, units and output fields before changing the merged artifact. Malformed responses preserve the last validated boundary. On resume, recheck source digests; changed sources invalidate affected interpretations and descendants.
common_protocol.resources: Use metadata/entity/feature checks before detailed curve intersection, kernel Boolean or tessellation work. Record local CPU/RAM and actual GPU role separately from remote model tokens/calls/latency/cost and manual effort. Qualitative estimates name entity/constraint/face/triangle count or operation complexity; measured values require fixture, machine, tool version, settings and run evidence. Parallel interpretation branches may be specified; local computational jobs follow the project scheduling rule.
common_protocol.migration: Proposed helpers become software paths per action and supported input class after authorized implementation and tests on checked success, ambiguous, invalid and interrupted cases. Record expected results before testing; publish observed results and route exceptions back to bounded agent/source review.

common_future_tests: Lost reasoning/VLM response, malformed feature-selection rows and changed source on resume: retain request/raw evidence and retry lineage; preserve merged artifact until valid source-linked selections exist; invalidate only affected descendants.
Producing and reviewing agents share a model family and a CAD reader shares the writer kernel: record these dependencies and keep semantic agreement separate from independent dimensional evidence.
Low-detail branch omits a required precision interface: preserve its layout status while blocking the interface-dependent use; merge rechecks its own actual geometry.

Required shape or solver query is unavailable: preserve returned data and diagnostic status, report the named check unresolved, and prevent a successful-process exit from becoming a geometry-validation pass.
